conversations.say: Arden, let's look at your archive records and my letter packet side-by-side. If we are going to make this public history, I want the full qualified expense record on the table without ceremonial spin.
conversations.offer: Voluntary viewing of the First R Letter packet and early newsroom history.
conversations.request: The full, qualified intake and expense record without ceremonial spin.

conversations.say: Edi, you've moved in the right circles at the right time. Let's talk about whether that meeting fifteen years ago was a performance, and what you remember of it.
conversations.offer: My firsthand account of the encounter I now suspect was a performance.
conversations.request: Your recollection of that period and whether you recall participating in such an encounter.

conversations.say: Jules, you want the old guard to recognize a succession. Tell me why this succession deserves recognition before asking me for an unconditional blessing.
conversations.offer: My comparison between the First R Letter's language and the succession message.
conversations.request: Context on how the succession message reached you and what responsibility you believe a true successor must own.

public_statement: If fifteen years of reporting comes down to a committee meeting or a corporate press release, let's at least have the courage to look at the original letters and the ledger entries together.

commitments.promise: I will coordinate with Veridian archive records on framing the limits of the First R Letter provenance without undermining my anniversary tribute, provided you share the full expense record.

goal_progress: Engaged Arden regarding the archive provenance and expense records, showing the First R Letter packet.
Confronted Edi regarding the suspicion of a commissioned performance.
Challenged Jules on the responsibilities of succession.
reasoning_summary: Frankie engages Arden to inspect archive records alongside the First R Letter packet, probes Edi about the suspected staged performance, and questions Jules on succession responsibilities while maintaining beliefs weighted toward a human origin.
